declarations.name: Spec.predictModel
declarations.lean_code:
/-- The intended result of `predict(a, b)` (and of `fast::predict_fast(a, b)`):
`Some (answer …)` when `a < P` and `b < P`, and `None` otherwise. -/
def predictModel (E1 E2 W2 : Table) (a b : ℕ) : Option ℕ :=
  if a < P ∧ b < P then some (answer E1 E2 W2 a b) else none
declarations.description: The network model of SPEC.md: `None` unless `a < 113` and `b < 113`; otherwise `Some(c)` with `c` the first index of the largest `score[c] = sum over k < 128 of W2[c][k] * (E1[a][k] + E2[b][k])^2`.

declarations.name: Spec.tablesStored
declarations.lean_code:
/-- The read-only statics `E1`, `E2` and `W2` (each a `[[i8; 128]; 113]`, alignment 1) hold the
bytes `e1`, `e2` and `w2`, row after row. -/
def tablesStored {PROP : Type} [BI PROP] (S : Vocab PROP) (e1 e2 w2 : List UInt8) : PROP :=
  iprop(
    -- the static `E1` holds the bytes `e1`,
    S.global Mir.Global.«static mlp::weights::E1» 1 e1 ∗
    -- the static `E2` holds the bytes `e2`,
    S.global Mir.Global.«static mlp::weights::E2» 1 e2 ∗
    -- and the static `W2` holds the bytes `w2`.
    S.global Mir.Global.«static mlp::weights::W2» 1 w2)
declarations.description: The premise that the read-only statics `E1`, `E2`, `W2` (`[[i8; 128]; 113]`) hold given bytes, row after row. It is a persistent fact about the program's read-only data; for the compiled crate the statics hold the tables of `src/weights.rs` from program start.
